provenance.method: Current mygov.scot and Transport Scotland disabled concessionary travel information checked on 2026-08-28. Listing records the Scotland route without deciding individual eligibility.

name: Scotland disabled person's bus pass
description: The National Entitlement Card route for eligible disabled people living in Scotland to access concessionary bus travel.
intended_use: Check current Scotland eligibility, evidence and application routes for disabled concessionary bus travel.
audience_or_context: Disabled people living in Scotland who meet one of the current concessionary travel eligibility criteria.
limitations: Eligibility depends on current Scottish criteria and evidence.
The card does not cover every transport service or journey.
cost_or_access_notes: Eligible people can use the National Entitlement Card for free bus travel on covered services; application routes include online and local-authority routes.
conflicts_of_interest: mygov.scot and Transport Scotland are first-party public sources; ND Oracle does not determine individual eligibility.
